description: This file defines the NetworkInterface class, which provides an abstraction for network interface parameters such as name, address, operational state, broadcast address, and prefix length within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: NetworkInterface
classes.description: A class representing a network interface with methods to modify and access its parameters.

methods.name: NetworkInterface(size_t if_index)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the network interface with a specific index.

methods.name: SetName(const std::string& new_name)
methods.description: Sets the name of the network interface.

methods.name: Name() const
methods.description: Returns the name of the network interface.

methods.name: PrefixLength() const
methods.description: Returns the prefix length of the network interface.

methods.name: SetOperational(bool is_operational)
methods.description: Sets the operational state of the network interface.

methods.name: IsOperational() const
methods.description: Returns whether the network interface is operational (up).

methods.name: SetAddress(const std::string& address)
methods.description: Sets the IPv4 address of the network interface.

methods.name: Address() const
methods.description: Returns the IPv4 address of the network interface.

methods.name: SetBroadcastAddress(const std::string& address)
methods.description: Sets the IPv4 broadcast address of the network interface.

methods.name: BroadcastAddress() const
methods.description: Returns the IPv4 broadcast address of the network interface.
